front.title: Constitutional Action Gate Profile for Agent-Mediated Internet Operations

abstract.t: This document proposes CAG-1, an experimental, constrained decision profile for authorizing agent-mediated consequential effects at an enforcement point. It preserves the distinction between authenticated identity, qualified evidence, delegated permission, action approval, current epoch, and execution. The profile defines a strict JSON context, exact-effect binding, delegation attenuation, three-valued decision semantics, a replay/epoch admission example, and a synthetic conformance corpus. An ALLOW decision is not a new credential and does not prove execution, legal authority, scientific truth, or global revocation closure. This text is an unsubmitted working candidate; independent interoperability and security verification remain open.
